image_to_code_analysis.card_structure: Deconstructed from current baseline workstation: sharp 2px radius borders (#1A1A22), deep obsidian background (#0A0A0C) with slate elevated surfaces (#121215) and 16px section padding rhythm.
image_to_code_analysis.badge_and_accents: Technical monospace status indicators, phosphor green (#00FF66) active badges, cyan (#38BDF8) audio/hardware telemetry markers, and high-contrast pure white typography.
image_to_code_analysis.typography_hierarchy: JetBrains Mono display and telemetry readouts paired with clean Inter/system sans labels and controls under 72ch line length target.

layout.concept: Dark technical workstation media studio layout with three primary functional columns: (1) Left Control Panel hosting extended Signal Adjustments (Contrast, Brightness, Gamma, Exposure, Saturation, Sharpness, Invert, Sobel Edge Detection), Smart Background Removal (Threshold, Feather, Invert Mask, Auto Corner Sample badge), and Audio Passthrough Engine (Mute/Unmute, Volume Slider, Autoplay sync badge); (2) Center ASCII Viewport with real-time frame streaming and canvas matrix rendering; (3) Center/Right Fastfetch System Telemetry drawer rendering side-by-side terminal stats and ASCII logo without layout shift.

layout.alignment_rationale: Left-aligned multi-section parameter controls and dedicated center-right canvas/telemetry viewport guarantee zero layout shift during real-time 60 FPS video streaming and continuous slider manipulation.

principles: Conceived as an authentic dark technical engineering studio for high-contrast ASCII generation rather than a consumer web app. Uses deep obsidian and slate surfaces (#0A0A0C, #121215) with crisp 1px borders (#1A1A22), monospaced telemetry hierarchy, and focused phosphor/cyan accents (#00FF66, #38BDF8) strictly for system status indication. All controls strictly adhere to the locked page_copy and contracts without decorative AI gradients or fake SaaS badges.

orchestrated_moment.justification: Exactly ONE deliberate motion moment: toggling the Fastfetch System Telemetry widget executes a smooth 180ms ease-out slide-and-fade spring transition into the dual-viewport pane. All slider adjustments, tab switching, and audio toggles remain strictly static with instant zero-overhead DOM updates.

tells_checked: Checked cream/terracotta tell: rejected warm-clay and paper tints in favor of deliberate dark technical workstation obsidian void (#0A0A0C) and high-contrast text (#E2E8F0).

Checked near-black/acid-green slop tell: user brief explicitly mandates monochrome/dark technical workstation minimalism; deliberate override of color accents to phosphor green (#00FF66) and cyan (#38BDF8) strictly reserved for functional telemetry and active audio state indicators.
Checked broadsheet layout tell: rejected hairline newspaper columns in favor of modular workstation grid with left parameter drawer and dual ASCII/Fastfetch viewport.
Checked SaaS card kit tell: eliminated uniform rounded cards, soft-grey drop shadows, and decorative gradient washes; enforced crisp 2px terminal radii and 1px borders (#1A1A22).
Checked template chrome tell: removed tracked-out ALL-CAPS eyebrows, middot separators, and arrow CTA suffixes; locked to sentence-case control headers and monospace status readouts.
Checked untouched shadcn defaults: completely overrode border-radius, shadows, spacing, and CSS variable color palette to match the dark technical workstation contracts.
Checked blanket motion tell: capped animations at exactly ONE deliberate moment (Fastfetch widget slide-and-fade drawer reveal); all other controls and canvas renders remain static.
